## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest complete solution.

## Validation

List the manual checks you ran (see CONTRIBUTING.md's "Manual verification"
section) and their results. Note there's no automated test suite yet — a
manual walkthrough is expected.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused (one logical concern per PR).
- [ ] The dry-run default and the no-auto-submit safety gate are preserved.
- [ ] Affected documentation (`README.md`, env var tables, project
      structure) is updated.
- [ ] No API keys, real resumes, generated content, or tracker data are
      included.
- [ ] Any submitted fixtures are synthetic or clearly redacted.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under this project's
      MIT License.
